proposal_name: FCT-001 Android Toolchain & Application Build Quality Gate
notes: Proposed check extensions for Android Foundation & First Runnable APK. Preserves approved FCT-000 baseline checks (spec-hygiene, harness-selftests) and adds Gradle wrapper integrity, Android build, unit tests, lint, and APK validation. Runtime smoke test is executed separately when an authorized device is available.

checks.description: Validates markdown link integrity, cross-spec requirement traceability, defect registry schema, and anti-pattern rules.
Executes verification harness internal self-test suite and extracts structured metrics.
Verifies gradle-wrapper.jar SHA-256 against official Gradle releases checksum and checks wrapper properties.
Executes Android Lint on the application module and enforces zero errors and zero security regressions.
Executes JVM unit tests for Android application module via Gradle test adapter, enforcing XML freshness and extracting structured JUnit metrics.
Compiles and packages the debug APK (:app:assembleDebug).
Verifies debug APK existence, SHA-256, archive integrity, manifest attributes via apkanalyzer, signature via apksigner, and confirms zero proprietary vendor binaries.
